title: A document with a hyperlink
concept: A Hyperlink joins a text source in the story to a URL destination in the design map; the destination is named by a typed Properties child, and the block follows the last story.

annotations.note: HyperlinkURLDestination: the target. DestinationURL holds the web address. The whole navigation block comes after the last idPkg:Story include, or InDesign does not bind it.
Hyperlink: Source names the HyperlinkTextSource that wraps the linked words inside the story.
The destination is a typed Properties child that names the object as Type/Self. A Destination attribute is ignored by InDesign, and combined with DestinationUniqueKey it makes the file unopenable.
